title: Titanium “M” Plus Flame Powered Extraction Device (Fall Colours)
description:
Titanium “M” Plus (QuantiuM or NebuluM)
NON ELECTRIC FLAME POWERED DEVICE
Since the very beginning when DynaVap’s “M” range came out, it was always their most popular model. And now they have taken the “M” Plus to a new level with the edition of titanium in combination with some eye catching surface treatments. On this page you will see two variants of that. One being the NebuluM which is generally blue dominate with flashes of purple. Often blue turns to purple depending on the angle you look at it. The other version is the QantiuM which has a textured surface treatment that is mainly a plain titanium colour. And you can often also see light shades of purple/blue depending on how you look at it.
Designed to be used with dry herb or concentrates (
DynaCoil
adaptor sold separately), the “M” herbal vaporizer is more dynamic than smoking due to the thermal extraction of your material. You will stretch your stash, your flavour, and your wallet. This product provides a distinct vaping experience that retains the sought after smoking rituals.
The latest iteration of DynaVap’s flagship “M” dry herb vaporizer. The Titanium “M” Plus™ features a finless tip for quick heat up times, and a more pronounced airport for easier airflow control. The Titanium “M” Plus™ is made of medical grade stainless steel and includes the signature, temperature-indicating Captive Cap.
TITANIU”M” NEBULUM:
Color and Aesthetics: Features a unique coloration of a purple base with blue and violet hues, evoking the captivating colours of a Nebula. Its design is coloured but not textured, giving it a sleek finish.
Texture: Boasts the smooth Classic Stem design for a clean, streamlined grip.
Durability: Crafted from titanium and enhanced with DynaVap’s unique surface treatment for increased scratch resistance.
TITANIU”M” QUANTIUM:
Color and Aesthetics: Distinguished by its unique texture and coloured shine. The tip and stem are uniformly engraved for a touch of sophistication.
Texture: Provides a tactile sensation with its textured design, ensuring a more defined grip.
Durability: Made of titanium and treated for added durability, this model is resilient to wear and tear.
Both titanium vaporizers encapsulate DynaVap’s commitment to quality and exceptional performance, but your selection will be based on your personal aesthetic and tactile preferences.
Will fit in standard size DynaStashes or SlimStashes. Compatible with the DynaCoil.
Comes in boxed packaging that is recyclable.
Included
1 x Titanium “M” Plus (Please choose between NebuluM and QuantiuM)
